content: {"like":["Racing films need clear, directional audio with deep LFE and accurate panning","Sci‑fi action benefits from realistic CGI, vivid colors, and immersive 7.1 surround","Adventure epics appreciate high‑resolution video, natural skin tones, and detailed textures","Documentary‑style extras (making‑of, interviews) add value to action and historical films","Atmos or DTS‑HD 7.1 audio with discreet foley and strong bass enhances realism"],"dislike":["CGI that appears unrealistic or overly smoothed detracts from sci‑fi and fantasy","Compression from ads or previews reduces video bitrate and image quality","Lack of deep blacks or muted colors weakens visual impact in action and adventure","Audio lacking directional panning or a proper LFE channel feels flat","Absence of 7.1 or Atmos mixes limits immersive sound in modern blockbusters"]}
